name: text_to_speech
description: Convert text to speech using Soniox. Returns an MP3 audio file. Each call accepts at most 5000 characters, and the audio is silently cut at 2 minutes, so split long text across calls. Set language to the language the text is written in.

text.description: The text to convert to speech, up to 5000 characters.

voice.description: Soniox voice name or ID. Omit to use the configured default.

language.description: ISO language code of the text, for example en or el. Omit to use the configured default.
